review.tagline: Tauri desktop GUI for Claude Code projects, sessions and custom agents
review.summary: opcode is a Tauri 2 desktop app (React frontend, Rust backend, SQLite) that sits on top of the Claude Code CLI. It browses projects and sessions under ~/.claude/projects/, runs custom agents as separate processes, and tracks token usage and cost. It also manages MCP servers, session checkpoints with a diff viewer, and CLAUDE.md files.
review.audience: Claude Code users who want a desktop GUI for sessions, agents and usage tracking
strengths: Checkpoints with branching timeline, fork and diff viewer for Claude Code sessions
Usage dashboard breaks down tokens and cost by model, project and date, with export
Reads existing ~/.claude data and can import MCP servers from Claude Desktop
Data stays local in SQLite; README states no telemetry
weaknesses: Requires the Claude Code CLI; README mentions only Claude models
README says prebuilt executables are not yet published; build needs Rust and Bun
AGPL-3.0 license may restrict use in some organizations
Last tagged release is 2025-08-31, older than recent commits
needs: Needs Claude Code CLI, Rust 1.70+, Bun, Git
